verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a dedicated Order MCP server (get_order) that lets an agent fetch order state, fulfillment events, and post-purchase adjustments, plus a complementary order-webhooks channel for real-time updates, and the CLI quickstart explicitly includes 'Track an order after purchase' as a first-class step. Access requires Token-tier auth, which is a documented gate rather than a failure. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs.
